ios.desc:
Don’t just capture it. Snaplight it.

Snaplight 2 is now completely free, with all features unlocked. If you love it, you can support future updates with an optional one-time donation.

Snaplight is the fastest, easiest way to highlight anything in a photo or screenshot. Make your message clear, your ideas pop, and important details never get lost.

Whether it’s a quote, a diagram, a funny message, or a design reference, Snaplight lets you spotlight what matters and instantly fade everything else.

# Highlight anything in seconds

• Instant precision. Pinch to zoom, undo/redo freely, snap back anytime.
• Custom fades. Feather edges with adjustable blur for soft, subtle masks.
• Bold and vibrant. Choose from 13+ colors or fine-tune opacity.
• Smart text highlight. Instantly spotlight recognized text in any image.
• Effortless sharing. One-tap save and share via AirDrop, Messages, and more.

# Built for speed, loved for its design

• No clutter. No ads. Just results.
• Works beautifully on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
• Designed for creators, students, professionals, or anyone who communicates visually.

# Snaplight is perfect for

• Calling out key info from slides, notes, or textbooks.
• Creating clear, shareable visuals from messy screenshots.
• Spotlighting designs, content, or ideas for your team.
• Crafting clean, eye-catching posts for social media.

# Free forever

If you’d like to help support Snaplight’s continued development, you can make a one-time donation inside the app. No subscriptions, no pressure.

Snaplight turns clutter into clarity, fast.

Download Snaplight 2 today and see what stands out.

quotes.text:
You should follow the link to the AppStore where it says:

“This app is no longer supported by the developer“

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/snaplight-photo-highlighter/id977049674

He probably got 10,000 downloads a week while he was featured on that page then dropped to almost zero.  Millions of apps in the store means you won’t get much random traffic.
quotes.story_title: Oh shit, my weekend project turned into an App Store Best New App (2018)
